title: Rust: CRDT Counter
description: Implement Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDT) for distributed counters.

steps.title: G-Counter (Grow-Only)
steps.description: Implement a `GCounter` that can only increase. Uses per-node counts: `HashMap<String, u64>`. `value()` sums all node counts. `add(node, n)` increases node's count. `merge(other)` takes max per node.

verification.failureMessage: Create a GCounter, add values, print the total.

steps.title: PN-Counter (Positive-Negative)
steps.description: Implement a `PNCounter` using two GCounters: one for increments, one for decrements. `value()` = inc.value() - dec.value(). `add(n)` increments inc. `sub(n)` increments dec. Test with add 5, sub 3.

steps.title: Merging Replicas
steps.description: Create two replicas of a PNCounter. Replica A adds 10, Replica B adds 5. Merge A into B and B into A. Both should have value 15 after merging.

verification.failureMessage: Merge two replicas and print the converged value.

steps.title: Conflict Resolution
steps.description: Simulate a conflict: both replicas independently receive the same increment. Merge both ways and verify the value is correct (not double-counted).
hints: After merge: value should be 10, not 15.

verification.failureMessage: Merge after concurrent adds, value should be 10.

steps.title: G-Set (Grow-Only Set)
steps.description: Extend CRDT patterns to a `GSet<T>` (grow-only set). Elements can be added but never removed. Merge takes union. Test with two replicas adding different fruits.
hints: Two replicas → merged set has all elements from both.

verification.failureMessage: Merge two G-Set replicas and print all elements.
